procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
3-month follow-up after the stillbirth of her twins in September.

Back at work full time since 12/8. Says the routine has helped; coworkers were kind. The holidays were hard, and the due date in early December was the worst week. Went to the perinatal loss group twice and plans to keep going monthly. Sleeping 6 to 7 hours most nights now, appetite back, enjoying time with her child. No self-harm thoughts. Not drinking.
PHQ-9 today 4 (was 8 in October).

Physically fully recovered, incision no longer sore.

Glucose tolerance test in November normal.

Meds: prenatal vitamin with iron (keeping it up on OB's advice for now). NKDA.

Exam: vitals as charted, BP normal. Weight 84 kg, down 2 since October. Brighter affect, engaged, smiles. Heart regular. Lungs clear. Incision well healed.

Assessment/plan:
1. Grief after perinatal loss, improving; PHQ-9 4. Continue support group. Reach out if anything slides, especially around anniversaries.
2. History of GDM: OGTT normal; A1c yearly from the physical.
3. Obesity, BMI about 33: she'd like to return to the walking routine in spring; we'll revisit at the physical.
Physical in April (Pap due).

documents.title: Hospital Records
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, I'd like to keep a copy of everything from the hospital and the high-risk doctors for my own files. Do you have all of it? Can I get it from you?

documents.title: RE: Hospital Records
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Hi Wanda, we have the summaries the hospital and the OB/MFM offices sent us: the ED records, operative report, discharge summary, pathology and the visit letters. We've released those to your portal under Documents. The complete hospital chart, including ultrasound images, has to be requested from the hospital's medical records department directly; there is a request form on their website.

documents.title: Appointment Cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Patient called to cancel 3/10 follow-up due to a work conflict. Rather than rebook separately, she will cover it at her physical on 4/22.

reports.text: Specimen: cervical, liquid-based preparation. Specimen adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation; transformation zone component present. Interpretation: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy. High-risk HPV (including 16/18): not detected.
reports.conclusion: NILM; high-risk HPV not detected. Routine co-testing in 5 years.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual physical, 33-year-old woman.

Interval since January: steady. Working full time, walking at lunch three days a week since March. Still attends the loss group now and then. Sleep and appetite normal. Periods regular. No pelvic pain, discharge or bleeding between periods. No GI symptoms, no pain after meals.

PMH: obesity; history of gallstones (never symptomatic here); gestational diabetes 2025, resolved, normal postpartum GTT 11/2025; cesarean 9/2025 (stillbirth of MCMA twins at 30 weeks, complete previa).
OB: G2P1101.
Meds: prenatal vitamin with iron. NKDA.
Social: never smoker; no alcohol since the pregnancy; administrative coordinator.
FH: mother T2DM (45); maternal grandmother twins.
PHQ-9 3. AUDIT-C 0.

Exam: vitals as charted, BP normal. BMI about 32. Well appearing, good spirits. HEENT normal. Neck: no thyromegaly or nodes. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear. Breasts symmetric, no masses, skin or nipple changes, no axillary nodes. Abdomen soft, nontender; healed low transverse scar. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, vaginal walls normal, cervix without lesions, Pap with HPV co-test obtained; bimanual with normal-sized, nontender uterus and no adnexal masses. Extremities without edema. Skin normal.

A/P:
1. Preventive: Pap/HPV today. Flu and COVID vaccines current for the season. Tdap 9/2025.
2. History of GDM, family history of diabetes: A1c today and yearly.
3. Obesity, BMI 32: weight back to her pre-pregnancy baseline. Encouraged the walking; add strength twice a week. Not interested in medication.
4. Labs: CBC with diff, CMP, lipids, A1c, TSH.
5. Mood: grief well integrated, PHQ-9 3.
6. Future pregnancy questions: defer to OB/MFM as planned at her postpartum visit.
Return in the fall for follow-up and flu shot.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Wanda, your labs from Wednesday are all normal. A1c is in the normal range, so no sign of diabetes a year out from the gestational diabetes. Cholesterol, thyroid, blood count, kidney and liver tests are fine. The Pap result usually takes about a week; I'll message you when it's in.

documents.title: Pap Result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your Pap test is normal and the HPV test is negative. With both normal, the next one isn't due for 5 years, in 2031.

documents.title: RE: Pap Result
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Great, thank you! One less thing to worry about.

documents.title: Refill Request - Prenatal Vitamin
documents.author: pharmacy
documents.body: Refill request received electronically: prenatal multivitamin with iron, take 1 tablet daily, quantity 90. Prior prescription has no refills remaining.

documents.title: Refill Approved
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Prenatal vitamin with iron renewed, #90 with 3 refills, per standing protocol. Listed on active med list, last seen 4/22/26.

documents.title: Fall Appointment
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hello! The doctor said to come back in the fall for a check and flu shot. Is the first week of October ok? Afternoons are hard with work, mornings are better.

documents.title: RE: Fall Appointment
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Hi Wanda, you're booked for Tuesday, October 6 at 8:00 am for a follow-up visit, and we'll have the flu vaccine ready. You'll get a reminder a few days before.
